records.title: Hearing injuries due to atmospheric pressure changes in air and water survival training instructors
records.locator: Methods and Results, PDF pp. 3–4; 2017 row of Table 2, PDF p. 5
records.note: Records cover 20 instructors in Aragua with both air and water survival duties in 2012–2022. The 2017 case is recorded as decompression illness with hearing injury. The initiating activity is unknown. Two years shown as no record supply no surveillance zero.
